title: Feature request: BG value in Android notification bar
body:
I'm asking for implementation of xDrip+ feature to see the glucose value in the Notification bar. 
Here is an [example of implementation](https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Display/NumIconNotifArea.html)
And [here is ](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/222)where it all started in xDrip+ GitHub.

comments.body: Because this is not possible on all devices it will not be implemented, sorry
